title: Operator surface follow-ups: --config on cloud runs, skills diff/get --full, the harness inside the binary
description: Follow-ups found 2026-10-07 while setting ticfac up on a second machine (ralph) and refreshing the ticfac skill (#259): ba4 lets ticfac run --cloud take --config; g5f reports a stale installed skill copy; u2g prints a skill's references from the binary; 0ek ships the local pi harness inside the ticfac binary (esbuild bundle, go:embed, run with node — no npm), so local pi runs work in any repository and on any machine. Prerequisite for the first release (y9v).
acceptance_criteria: [A1] ticfac run <epic> --cloud --config claude runs the epic on the claude config (ba4). [A2] ticfac skills diff (or doctor) reports an installed ticfac skill older than the binary with the upgrade command (g5f). [A3] ticfac skills get ticfac --full prints SKILL.md and every references file (u2g). [A4] a local pi-durable run in a repository that is not ticfac, with only the ticfac binaries and node, dispatches and completes a worker; a stale embedded harness bundle fails the gate (0ek). [A5] make gate passes and CI is green on the epic PR.
